title: South Korea vs Taiwan: Which Should You Visit?

faqs.question: Is South Korea or Taiwan cheaper?
faqs.answer: Taiwan is slightly cheaper overall. A mid-range day in Taiwan runs $50-80 USD; South Korea runs $70-110 USD. Taiwan's night markets offer incredible street food for $1-4 per item. Seoul has some budget options (gimbap cafes, Korean BBQ at local spots) but accommodation and shopping tend to cost more

faqs.question: Which has better food, South Korea or Taiwan?
faqs.answer: Both are world-class food destinations — it's genuinely close. Taiwan's night market street food culture (scallion pancakes, stinky tofu, oyster vermicelli, bubble tea from its birthplace) is legendary. South Korea's dining culture includes Korean BBQ, bibimbap, tteokbokki, fried chicken, and ramyeo

faqs.question: Is South Korea or Taiwan better for solo travelers?
faqs.answer: Both are excellent solo destinations with low crime, great public transport, and welcoming locals. Taiwan edges ahead for solo ease — English is more widely spoken in tourist areas, the country is smaller and easier to navigate, and Taiwanese people are famously helpful to foreign visitors. faqs.question: What is the best time to visit South Korea vs Taiwan?
faqs.answer: South Korea: spring (March-May for cherry blossoms) and autumn (September-November for fall foliage) are the highlights. Avoid July-August (hot and humid). Taiwan: October-April is ideal, avoiding typhoon season (June-September). Spring cherry blossoms happen in Taiwan too (Alishan, Wuling Farm).

faqs.question: How many days do you need in South Korea vs Taiwan?
faqs.answer: For South Korea, 7-10 days covers Seoul well plus a day trip to the DMZ or Gyeongju. 12-14 days lets you add Busan and Jeju Island. For Taiwan, 7-10 days covers Taipei plus Jiufen, Sun Moon Lake, and Taroko Gorge. Taiwan is smaller and more compact.

faqs.question: Is South Korea or Taiwan better for K-pop fans?
faqs.answer: South Korea, obviously. Seoul's Gangnam district, HYBE headquarters (BTS, TXT), SM Entertainment fan cafes in Apgujeong, music shows (M Countdown, Music Bank), and the Hongdae live music scene make Korea the definitive K-pop pilgrimage destination. Taiwan has no equivalent.

faqs.question: Can you visit both South Korea and Taiwan in one trip?
faqs.answer: Absolutely — this is a great combo. Direct flights between Seoul (Incheon) and Taipei (Taoyuan) take about 2.5 hours and can be very affordable ($80-150 one-way). A 2-week itinerary of 7-8 days in Korea plus 6-7 days in Taiwan is a classic East Asia circuit popular on r/solotravel and r/travel.
